about.metaDescription: The story behind Mr. Paps: fashion that speaks quietly, garments made with intention, and a genuine commitment to quality.

manifesto.body: Mr. Paps was born from a conviction: the most powerful fashion doesn't shout. It speaks through details, through the drape of a fabric, through the precision of a finish. We create for those who understand that.

story.paragraph1: Why does clothing that truly expresses who you are have to be scarce, inaccessible, or generic? That question was the origin of Mr. Paps.
story.paragraph2: We started with a simple premise: signature quality, without the middlemen who raise prices without adding value. Made-to-order production, with selected materials and obsessive attention to every garment's finish.
story.paragraph3: Today we're a brand that blends editorial identity with everyday comfort. Garments that feel good because they're well made — not because a logo says they should.
story.quote: "The perfect garment is one that goes unnoticed by everyone except the person wearing it."

items.title: QUIET LUXURY
items.body: Garments that don't need to announce themselves. Real luxury is invisible to those who can't see it — and completely legible to those who can.

items.title: CONSCIOUS PRODUCTION
items.body: Every piece is made once your order comes in. No mass inventory, no waste. Your purchase has a purpose before it reaches your hands.

items.title: TIMELESS DESIGN
items.body: We don't chase trends: we observe them, filter them, and create something that lasts. Collections built to outlive a single season.

process.description: Every order kicks off its own production chain. Nothing sits in a warehouse: your piece is made specifically for you.

steps.title: Choose your piece
steps.body: Browse the catalog, pick color, size, and quantity. No minimums, no waiting for restocks.

steps.title: Made just for you
steps.body: Your order goes into production the moment it's confirmed. High-resolution printing on premium materials.

steps.title: Packed and shipped
steps.body: Your piece is checked, packed, and shipped straight to you. Real-time tracking from day one.

shippingReturnsMx.metaDescription: Mr. Paps shipping and returns policy. Shipped nationwide in Mexico in 5–14 business days.
shippingReturnsMx.title: Shipping & Returns
shippingReturnsMx.subtitle: All our products are made to order. Here's what to expect on delivery times and our returns policy.

shipping.title: Shipping
shipping.delivery: Our products are made and printed once we receive your order. Estimated delivery is 5 to 14 business days from payment confirmation, depending on your location.
shipping.cost: The cost is calculated automatically once you enter your address at checkout, before you pay. We select the cheapest available rate.
shipping.tracking: Once your order ships, you'll get a tracking number by email to follow the delivery in real time.
shipping.note: Delivery times are estimates. Weather, holidays, or carrier congestion may affect them.

returns.title: Returns & Refunds
returns.intro: Since every product is made specifically for your order, we don't accept returns for buyer's remorse. We do stand behind the quality of our products.
returns.defectsBody: If your product arrives with a print defect, fabric damage, or the wrong item (size or product), you have 5 business days from delivery to report it.
returns.defectsSendTo: Send us photo evidence of the defect to
returns.defectsResolution: . We'll arrange a free reshipment or a full refund.
returns.cancelBody: You can cancel your order before it enters production. Once production has started, the order cannot be cancelled or modified.
returns.cancelContact: To request a cancellation, contact us right away via

warranty.title: Product Warranty
warranty.intro: All our products carry the minimum mandatory warranty under Mexico's Federal Consumer Protection Law (LFPC):
warranty.printDefects: Print or manufacturing defects: 6 months from date of purchase
warranty.fabricDefects: Fabric defects: 6 months from date of purchase
warranty.exclusion: The warranty does not cover damage from improper use, discoloration from incorrect washing (check the care label), or normal wear and tear.
